title: Test explicit stem-boundary uncertainty against planted Latin recovery
statement: A three-start, eight-iteration HMM marginalizes eligible stem-ending splits learned from ciphertext. In 36 held-apart real-planted settings on Caesar, Bede, and Thomas à Kempis, mean letter accuracy is 10.98%, versus 23.95% for the prior hard stem model and 29.61% for the frequency oracle with true row IDs. Best soft exact accuracy is 21.63%, and the model beats the prior in five of 36 settings. After an evaluator-only optimal relabeling of the 24 states its mean is 23.98%, so renaming states only partly explains the failure. Full table plus known row gives 100% candidate coverage and at least 99.95% exact top-1 on all 60 runs. On a separate Daniel control with the true role partition exposed only through a one-to-one symbol permutation, the soft search reaches 73.6%, compared with 9.03% under the actual cipher on that calibration text. Fit-window lag selection recovers all 30 fixed cyclic schedules and none of 30 iid-row schedules. In cyclic period-24 controls, the soft likelihood detects held-out order in six of six unigram iid texts under global shuffles and zero of six under inferred-period conditioning. The conditioned check still detects all six Markov controls. The measured order sensitivity and the measured letter recovery are separate outcomes. No manuscript inference was made.
check: Reproduce the matrices and paired cases with the frozen corpus hashes, seeds and budgets. Try a grouping model with explicit alternative row partitions and a cross-word constraint on role assignments across each inferred row. Test the result on fresh lengths, uncertain transcription, unrelated sources and unseen row sets, with exact letters as the primary endpoint. Record oracle-row and known-table tests, independently infer the cycle period on fitting data, and keep contextual Markov controls when interpreting held-apart likelihood.

protocol:
# Blind Polygraphia III recovery plan

Learn letter transitions and frequencies from prior Latin reference pins
Augustine, Patrick, Erasmus and Esther. Use Daniel only for independent
calibration checks, not as a language-model source, and use newly acquired
disjoint-author Latin texts for evaluation. Filter normalized letters to
the verified 24-letter Hermes alphabet. Fit the first 18,000 enciphered
tokens of each new work, and score the next 6,000. Letters, true rows,
their schedules and the table stay in the evaluation wrapper, separate
from the learned decoder.

Use two fixed row seeds (19041 and 19103, offset by 10000 per target work).
Compare real text at 10, 24 and 131 distinct rows with both iid row and
cyclic row selection. Add independent reference-unigram iid and
reference-bigram Markov plaintext controls at 24 rows under both row
selection schemes with the same seed family. All books and variants
share a frozen search budget. Reference texts, calibration and test cases
are separate. The same book is reused across distinct keys and controls.

Fit a sparse conditional word-form channel. At every train spelling
consider proper prefix lengths >=2, suffixes of 1–4 characters, at least
three distinct forms sharing the prefix and at least two different eligible
prefixes sharing the suffix. Include a fallback two-character suffix.
Within each word weight each eligible candidate by the square root of
prefix support times suffix-prefix support, with fallback weight one.
Normalize weights within spelling, then normalize each suffix over
observed word types. This marginalizes ambiguous stem/ending boundaries.
The language model is a fixed add-one 24x24 reference transition matrix
with fixed external unigram initial distribution.

The HMM emission matrix is Q(word|ending) × theta(ending|letter). Three
starts, eight forward–backward EM iterations per start. Initialization
ranks endings by their observed mass per distinct supporting prefix and
puts the first 24 into one-to-one correspondence with frequent reference
letters, with seeded perturbations of ranking for starts two and three.
Smooth with fixed Dirichlet pseudocount .25 and retain the best training
MAP objective. Reserve .005 test emission mass for a single UNK category
with equal probability across letters. Use only the frozen learned
emissions and Latin transitions to infer held-apart letters. Viterbi is
not required for per-letter posterior-argmax accuracy. Report training
optimization, per-token confidence, rank and character accuracy,
calibration on low/non-language inputs, macro observed word-type accuracy,
alphabet use and transfer to unseen spellings.

Compare against the prior two-sweep suffix-plus-stem heuristic and a
row-ID frequency ranking oracle. A full table+row oracle provides a
separate identification ceiling and explicitly scores candidate-set
coverage and top-1. No learned model is given row or letter supervision;
a separate global one-to-one symbol permutation tests ideal morphology.
Use no synthetic or historical test plaintext to select model weights.

When estimating periodicity use the fixed 2..160 equality rate search,
49 global-permutation maximum draws on the first 4,000 fit tokens and
49 fixed-lag confirmation draws on the next 4,000 fit tokens. Use a fresh
seed per stage. No selection or failed confirmation remains missing.
Use any confirmed fit-only period for within-phase held-apart order
permutations. Report separately an oracle-phase test for cyclic schedules,
and global permutations, with one-sided NLL-based add-one p and 19 nulls.
A significant ordering check can also occur on a non-semantic Markov
control. Do not run any manuscript case.
diagnostic_protocol:
# Post-fit diagnostic

Distinguish incorrect letter names from incorrect latent text partitions.
As a retrospective diagnostic only, count decoded-versus-true letter
confusions on the already allocated evaluation window and compute the
maximum number correct under any global one-to-one permutation of letter
names by linear assignment. Report the majority score that sees the test
letter histogram as a second diagnostic. Both use evaluation truth and
neither informs fit, initialization, or selection of an experimental
decoder. Preserve the original exact-accuracy data and report this as
an optimistic diagnostic rather than key recovery.

validation.state_recursion: Scaled C forward-backward agrees with explicit enumeration of all 16 paths on a fixed two-state sequence to 1e-13.
validation.prior_port: Independent checks against the archived two-sweep routine matched all word and suffix maps and all 1,600 held-out predictions across four synthetic conditions.
validation.emap: The EM objective is nondecreasing at every recorded iteration, with a fixed Dirichlet prior.
validation.robustness: Adding the evaluator-only relabel diagnostic leaves all original exact predictions and the period status identical at the aggregate per run level.

"""Independent Latin planted controls for uncertain-ending decipherment."""
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import runpy
import sys

import numpy as np
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
from scipy.special import xlogy
from vs import path, refcorpus

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOFT = runpy.run_path(str(WORK / "soft-decoder.py"))
TABLE_HASH = "fe3f24a46dbc6b655eab8dbbd75addf84ee4a7dbd387ad802af75d02edfe5b4d"
REFERENCE = ("la_augustine", "la_patrick", "la_erasmus", "la_vulg_esther_a")
TRAIN = 18000
TEST = 6000
SEEDS = (19041, 19103)
SCENARIOS = [(n, mode, "real") for n in (10, 24, 131) for mode in ("random", "cyclic")]
SCENARIOS += [(24, mode, kind) for mode in ("random", "cyclic") for kind in ("iid", "markov")]


def table_and_language():
    data = (WORK / "hermes-polygraphia-iii.csv").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == TABLE_HASH
    table = list(csv.DictReader(data.decode("utf-8-sig").splitlines()))
    alphabet = tuple(table[0])
    cells = np.array([[r[c].strip() for c in alphabet] for r in table])
    pi = np.ones(len(alphabet))
    transition = np.ones((len(alphabet), len(alphabet)))
    for name in REFERENCE:
        pin = next(p for p in refcorpus.pins() if p["id"] == name)
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path(pin["file"])).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pin["sha256"]
        source = "".join(refcorpus.blocks_of(name))
        data = letter_codes(source, alphabet)
        np.add.at(pi, data, 1)
        np.add.at(transition, (data[:-1], data[1:]), 1)
    pi /= pi.sum()
    transition /= transition.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return alphabet, cells, pi, transition


def letter_codes(source, alphabet):
    ids = {letter: i for i, letter in enumerate(alphabet)}
    return np.array([ids[c] for c in source if c in ids], dtype=np.int32)


def plant(stream, rows, mode, kind, seed, table, pi, transition):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    np_rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 9200)
    cycle = rng.sample(range(len(table)), rows)
    if mode == "cyclic":
        row_index = np.resize(cycle, len(stream))
    else:
        row_index = np.array([cycle[rng.randrange(rows)] for _ in stream], dtype=np.int32)
    if kind == "iid":
        stream = np_rng.choice(len(pi), size=len(stream), p=pi)
    elif kind == "markov":
        stream = np.zeros(len(stream), dtype=np.int32)
        stream[0] = np_rng.choice(len(pi), p=pi)
        cdf = transition.cumsum(axis=1)
        for j, u in enumerate(np_rng.random(len(stream) - 1), 1):
            stream[j] = int(np.searchsorted(cdf[stream[j - 1]], u))
    return table[row_index, stream], row_index, stream


def hard_stem_labels(types):
    prefix = Counter()
    for word in types:
        for i in range(2, len(word)):
            prefix[word[:i]] += 1
    groups = []
    for word in types:
        options = [word[:i] for i in range(2, len(word)) if prefix[word[:i]] >= 4]
        groups.append(options[-1] if options else "UNMATCHED:" + word)
    return groups


def fit_hard(sequence, key, score, pi, groups=None):
    key = np.array(key, dtype=np.int32)
    states = len(pi)
    ntypes = len(key)
    ids, freq = np.unique(sequence, return_counts=True)
    assert np.array_equal(ids, np.arange(ntypes))
    n = len(sequence)
    target = n * pi
    letters = np.bincount(key, weights=freq, minlength=states).astype(np.int32)
    edge = Counter(zip(sequence[:-1], sequence[1:]))
    incoming = defaultdict(list)
    outgoing = defaultdict(list)
    own = np.zeros(ntypes, dtype=np.int32)
    for (a, b), count in edge.items():
        if a == b:
            own[a] = count
        else:
            outgoing[a].append((b, count))
            incoming[b].append((a, count))
    oi = {i: np.array(row, dtype=np.int32).T for i, row in outgoing.items()}
    ii = {i: np.array(row, dtype=np.int32).T for i, row in incoming.items()}
    if groups is not None:
        names = {g: j for j, g in enumerate(sorted(set(groups)))}
        gid = np.array([names[g] for g in groups])
        assigned = np.zeros((len(names), states), dtype=np.int32)
        np.add.at(assigned, (gid, key), 1)

    def objective():
        seq = key[sequence]
        value = score[seq[:-1], seq[1:]].sum() - 3 * xlogy(letters, letters / target).sum()
        if groups is not None:
            value -= 6 * (assigned * (assigned - 1)).sum()
        return value

    starting_value = objective()
    for _ in range(2):
        for i, count in enumerate(freq):
            prev = key[i]
            local = own[i] * score.diagonal().copy()
            if i in oi:
                roots, weight = oi[i]
                local += score[:, key[roots]] @ weight
            if i in ii:
                roots, weight = ii[i]
                local += weight @ score[key[roots], :]
            increase = letters + count
            removed = letters[prev] - count
            baseline = xlogy(letters, letters / target)
            delta = xlogy(increase, increase / target) - baseline
            delta += xlogy(removed, removed / target[prev]) - baseline[prev]
            delta[prev] = 0
            local -= 3 * delta
            if groups is not None:
                g = gid[i]
                conflicts = assigned[g] - (assigned[g, prev] - 1)
                conflicts[prev] = 0
                local -= 12 * conflicts
            picked = int(np.argmax(local))
            if picked != prev:
                letters[prev] -= count
                letters[picked] += count
                if groups is not None:
                    assigned[g, prev] -= 1
                    assigned[g, picked] += 1
                key[i] = picked
    assert objective() >= starting_value - 1e-6
    return key


def prior_decoder(train, test, pi, transition, alphabet):
    endings = sorted(set(w[-2:] for w in train))
    ending_ids = {w: i for i, w in enumerate(endings)}
    sequence = np.array([ending_ids[w[-2:]] for w in train], dtype=np.int32)
    masses = np.bincount(sequence)
    order = np.argsort(-masses, kind="stable")
    rank = np.array(sorted(range(len(pi)), key=lambda j: (-pi[j], alphabet[j])))
    initial = np.full(len(endings), rank[0], dtype=np.int32)
    use = min(len(endings), len(rank))
    initial[order[:use]] = rank[:use]
    log_transition = np.log(transition)
    fitted = fit_hard(sequence, initial, log_transition, pi)
    words = sorted(set(train))
    word_ids = {w: i for i, w in enumerate(words)}
    word_seq = np.array([word_ids[w] for w in train], dtype=np.int32)
    initialization = [fitted[ending_ids[w[-2:]]] for w in words]
    key = fit_hard(word_seq, initialization, log_transition, pi, hard_stem_labels(words))
    low = {w: int(a) for w, a in zip(endings, fitted)}
    high = {w: int(a) for w, a in zip(words, key)}
    return np.array([high.get(w, low.get(w[-2:], rank[0])) for w in test], dtype=np.int32)


def known_row_frequency(train, rtrain, test, rtest, pi, alphabet):
    per_row = defaultdict(Counter)
    order = sorted(range(len(pi)), key=lambda j: (-pi[j], alphabet[j]))
    for row, word in zip(rtrain, train):
        per_row[row][word] += 1
    mapping = {}
    for row, wc in per_row.items():
        for token, letter in zip(sorted(wc, key=lambda w: (-wc[w], w)), order):
            mapping[(row, token)] = letter
    known = [(row, word) in mapping for row, word in zip(rtest, test)]
    answers = [mapping.get((row, word), order[0]) for row, word in zip(rtest, test)]
    return np.array(answers, dtype=np.int32), float(np.mean(known))


def full_row_table(held, rows, truth, table, pi):
    candidates = [np.flatnonzero(table[row] == word) for row, word in zip(rows, held)]
    oracle = np.array([options[np.argmax(pi[options])] for options in candidates])
    return {"best_by_unigram_accuracy": float(np.mean(oracle == truth)),
            "candidate_set_accuracy": float(np.mean([t in options for t, options in zip(truth, candidates)])),
            "ambiguous_tokens": sum(len(options) > 1 for options in candidates)}


def report_accuracy(answer, words, truth, pi):
    right = answer == truth
    types = defaultdict(list)
    for word, is_right in zip(words, right):
        types[word].append(bool(is_right))
    p = np.bincount(answer, minlength=len(pi)) / len(answer)
    confusion = np.zeros((len(pi), len(pi)), dtype=np.int32)
    np.add.at(confusion, (answer, truth), 1)
    rows, columns = linear_sum_assignment(confusion, maximize=True)
    return {"accuracy": float(right.mean()),
            "test_only_global_relabel_accuracy": float(confusion[rows, columns].sum() / len(answer)),
            "test_only_majority_frequency": float(np.bincount(truth, minlength=len(pi)).max() / len(truth)),
            "macro_type_accuracy": float(np.mean([np.mean(use) for use in types.values()])),
            "decoded_letter_types": int(np.count_nonzero(p)),
            "max_letter_share": float(p.max()),
            "letter_kl": float(xlogy(p, p / pi).sum())}


def lag_scan(training, seed):
    encoded = np.unique(training, return_inverse=True)[1]
    train, confirm = encoded[:4000], encoded[4000:8000]
    lags = np.arange(2, 161)

    def rate(a):
        view = sliding_window_view(np.pad(a, (0, 160), constant_values=-1), 161)
        return np.count_nonzero(a[:, None] == view[:, 2:], axis=0) / (len(a) - lags)

    def single(a, k):
        return float(np.mean(a[:-k] == a[k:]))

    observed = rate(train)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 490)
    maxima = np.array([rate(rng.permutation(train)).max() for _ in range(49)])
    p = (1 + np.count_nonzero(maxima[:, None] >= observed, axis=0)) / 50
    support = np.flatnonzero(p <= 0.05)
    if not len(support):
        return {"selected": None, "confirmed": None}
    chosen = int(support[0])
    lag = int(lags[chosen])
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 491)
    v = single(confirm, lag)
    ptest = (1 + sum(single(rng.permutation(confirm), lag) >= v for _ in range(49))) / 50
    return {"selected": lag, "confirmed": lag if ptest <= 0.05 else None,
            "p_scan": float(p[chosen]), "p_confirm": ptest}


def order_null(ids, prediction, emission, pi, transition, seed, periods):
    ll, _ = SOFT["forward_backward"](ids, emission, pi, transition, posterior=False)
    log_t = np.log(transition)
    hard_ll = float(log_t[prediction[:-1], prediction[1:]].sum())
    rates = {}
    cache = {}
    for name, k in periods.items():
        if k is None:
            rates[name] = None
            continue
        if k not in cache:
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 610 + k)
            higher_soft = higher_hard = 0
            for _ in range(19):
                order = np.arange(len(ids))
                for j in range(k):
                    order[j::k] = rng.permutation(order[j::k])
                value, _ = SOFT["forward_backward"](ids[order], emission, pi, transition, posterior=False)
                hard = prediction[order]
                higher_soft += value >= ll
                higher_hard += log_t[hard[:-1], hard[1:]].sum() >= hard_ll
            cache[k] = {"soft_nll_p": (1 + higher_soft) / 20, "prior_hard_nll_p": (1 + higher_hard) / 20}
        rates[name] = cache[k]
    return rates


def test_models(words, rows, plaintext, train, seed, row_count, mode, alphabet, table, pi, transition):
    fit_words, held = words[:train], words[train:]
    truth = plaintext[train:]
    vocab, emission, parameters = SOFT["fit"](fit_words, pi, transition, seed)
    ids = SOFT["transform"](held, vocab)
    ll, posterior = SOFT["forward_backward"](ids, emission, pi, transition)
    top = posterior.argmax(axis=1)
    prev = prior_decoder(fit_words, held, pi, transition, alphabet)
    oracle, scope = known_row_frequency(fit_words, rows[:train], held, rows[train:], pi, alphabet)
    known = ids < len(vocab)
    rankings = np.argsort(-posterior, axis=1)
    confidence = posterior.max(axis=1)
    confidence_stats = []
    for i in range(5):
        mask = (confidence >= i / 5) & (confidence < (i + 1) / 5 if i < 4 else confidence <= 1)
        if mask.any():
            confidence_stats.append({"bin_low": i / 5, "tokens": int(mask.sum()),
                                     "accuracy": float(np.mean(top[mask] == truth[mask])),
                                     "mean_confidence": float(confidence[mask].mean())})
    lag = lag_scan(fit_words, seed)
    periods = {"global": 1, "inferred": lag["confirmed"], "oracle_cyclic": row_count if mode == "cyclic" else None}
    order_tests = order_null(ids, prev, emission, pi, transition, seed, periods)
    collided = defaultdict(Counter)
    for w, c in zip(held, truth):
        collided[w][int(c)] += 1
    result = {
        "soft": report_accuracy(top, held, truth, pi) | {
            "prediction_token_nll": -ll / len(held),
            "mean_top_posterior": float(confidence.mean()),
            "top3_accuracy": float(np.mean(np.any(rankings[:, :3] == truth[:, None], axis=1))),
            "known_type_accuracy": float(np.mean(top[known] == truth[known])) if known.any() else None,
            "oov_accuracy": float(np.mean(top[~known] == truth[~known])) if (~known).any() else None,
            "confidence_bins": confidence_stats,
        },
        "prior": report_accuracy(prev, held, truth, pi),
        "row_frequency": report_accuracy(oracle, held, truth, pi) | {"known_word_in_row_share": scope},
        "row_table": full_row_table(held, rows[train:], truth, table, pi),
        "oov_share": float(np.mean(~known)),
        "test_spelling_only_ceiling": sum(max(v.values()) for v in collided.values()) / len(held),
        "fit": parameters,
        "lag": lag,
        "held_order_nulls": order_tests,
    }
    return result


def main(calibration_only=False):
    alphabet, table, pi, transition = table_and_language()
    data = json.loads((WORK / "external-texts.json").read_text())
    if calibration_only:
        plain = letter_codes("".join(refcorpus.blocks_of("la_vulg_daniel")), alphabet)[:16000]
        assert len(plain) == 16000
        words, rows, truth = plant(plain, 24, "cyclic", "real", 48101, table, pi, transition)
        result = test_models(words, rows, truth, 12000, 48101, 24, "cyclic", alphabet, table, pi, transition)
        rng = np.random.default_rng(92401)
        symbols = np.array(["symbol" + chr(97+i) + chr(97+i) for i in rng.permutation(len(pi))])
        grouping = symbols[plain]
        index, emission, fits = SOFT["fit"](grouping[:12000], pi, transition, 92401)
        ids = SOFT["transform"](grouping[12000:], index)
        _, probs = SOFT["forward_backward"](ids, emission, pi, transition)
        perfect = report_accuracy(probs.argmax(axis=1), grouping[12000:], plain[12000:], pi)
        (WORK / "calibration.json").write_text(json.dumps({"historical":result,
                    "perfect_grouping": perfect | {"fit":fits}}, indent=2) + "\n")
        return

    records = []
    for i, (name, source) in enumerate(data.items()):
        text = (WORK / source["file"]).read_text()
        plain = letter_codes(text, alphabet)[:TRAIN + TEST]
        assert len(plain) == TRAIN + TEST, name
        for seed in SEEDS:
            effective = seed + 10000 * i
            for row_count, mode, kind in SCENARIOS:
                words, rows, planted = plant(plain, row_count, mode, kind, effective, table, pi, transition)
                details = test_models(words, rows, planted, TRAIN, effective, row_count, mode,
                                      alphabet, table, pi, transition)
                records.append(details | {"source": name, "seed": effective,
                                          "rows": row_count, "mode": mode, "kind": kind})
            location = WORK / f"progress-{len(records):02}.json"
            location.write_text(json.dumps(records, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
            print(name, effective, len(records), flush=True)
    (WORK / "recovery-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main("--calibration" in sys.argv)

"""Ciphertext-only marginalization over uncertain word endings."""
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import ctypes as ct
from pathlib import Path
import math

import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LIBRARY = ct.CDLL(str(WORK / "fb.so"))
FUNCTION = LIBRARY.forward_backward
INT = np.ctypeslib.ndpointer(dtype=np.int32, ndim=1, flags="C_CONTIGUOUS")
DOUBLE2 = np.ctypeslib.ndpointer(dtype=np.float64, ndim=2, flags="C_CONTIGUOUS")
DOUBLE1 = np.ctypeslib.ndpointer(dtype=np.float64, ndim=1, flags="C_CONTIGUOUS")
FUNCTION.argtypes = [ct.c_int, ct.c_int, INT, DOUBLE2, DOUBLE1, DOUBLE2, ct.c_void_p]
FUNCTION.restype = ct.c_double

STARTS = 3
ITERATIONS = 8
PSEUDOCOUNT = 0.25
OOV_MASS = 0.005


def forward_backward(ids, emissions, initial, transition, posterior=True):
    ids = np.asarray(ids, dtype=np.int32, order="C")
    emissions = np.asarray(emissions, dtype=np.float64, order="C")
    initial = np.asarray(initial, dtype=np.float64, order="C")
    transition = np.asarray(transition, dtype=np.float64, order="C")
    states = len(initial)
    assert transition.shape == (states, states) and emissions.shape[1] == states
    assert ids.size and ids.min() >= 0 and ids.max() < emissions.shape[0]
    probs = np.empty((len(ids), states), dtype=np.float64) if posterior else None
    ptr = probs.ctypes.data_as(ct.c_void_p) if posterior else None
    likelihood = FUNCTION(len(ids), states, ids, emissions, initial, transition, ptr)
    assert math.isfinite(likelihood)
    return likelihood, probs


def build_channel(words):
    vocabulary = sorted(set(words))
    type_ids = {word: i for i, word in enumerate(vocabulary)}
    ids = np.array([type_ids[word] for word in words], dtype=np.int32)
    prefix_support = Counter()
    for word in vocabulary:
        for ending_len in range(1, min(4, len(word) - 2) + 1):
            prefix_support[word[:-ending_len]] += 1
    compatible = defaultdict(set)
    for word in vocabulary:
        for ending_len in range(1, min(4, len(word) - 2) + 1):
            stem, ending = word[:-ending_len], word[-ending_len:]
            if prefix_support[stem] >= 3:
                compatible[ending].add(stem)
    rows, columns, values = [], [], []
    indices = {}
    ambiguous_types = 0
    for i, word in enumerate(vocabulary):
        features = {word[-2:]: 1.0}
        for ending_len in range(1, min(4, len(word) - 2) + 1):
            stem, ending = word[:-ending_len], word[-ending_len:]
            if prefix_support[stem] >= 3 and len(compatible[ending]) >= 2:
                features[ending] = features.get(ending, 0.0) + math.sqrt(
                    prefix_support[stem] * len(compatible[ending])
                )
        ambiguous_types += len(features) > 1
        weight = sum(features.values())
        for ending, value in sorted(features.items()):
            index = indices.setdefault(ending, len(indices))
            rows.append(i)
            columns.append(index)
            values.append(value / weight)
    shares = coo_matrix((values, (rows, columns)), shape=(len(vocabulary), len(indices))).tocsr()
    exposure = np.array([max(1, len(compatible[tag])) for tag in indices])
    occurrence = np.bincount(ids, minlength=len(vocabulary))
    weighted_frequency = np.asarray(shares.T @ occurrence).ravel()
    suffix_weights = weighted_frequency / exposure
    column_sum = np.asarray(shares.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    channel = shares.multiply(1 / column_sum).tocsr()
    assert np.allclose(np.asarray(channel.sum(axis=0)).ravel(), 1)
    return type_ids, ids, occurrence, channel, suffix_weights, ambiguous_types


def fit(words, initial, transition, seed):
    type_ids, ids, occurrence, channel, ending_rank, ambiguous = build_channel(words)
    states = len(initial)
    order = np.argsort(-ending_rank, kind="stable")
    rank = np.argsort(-initial, kind="stable")
    base = rank[np.arange(len(order)) % states]
    weights = 0.25 + ending_rank / max(float(ending_rank.mean()), 1e-9)
    best = None
    diagnostics = []
    for start in range(STARTS):
        rng = np.random.default_rng([seed, start])
        assignment = base.copy()
        if start:
            for a, b in rng.integers(0, min(states, len(order)), size=(3, 2)):
                assignment[a], assignment[b] = assignment[b], assignment[a]
        theta = np.broadcast_to(weights[:, None], (len(order), states)).copy()
        theta[order, assignment] *= 8.0
        theta /= theta.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
        objectives = []
        for _ in range(ITERATIONS + 1):
            emission = channel @ theta
            ll, gamma = forward_backward(ids, emission, initial, transition)
            objectives.append(ll + PSEUDOCOUNT * float(np.log(theta).sum()))
            if len(objectives) == ITERATIONS + 1:
                break
            count = np.zeros_like(emission)
            for j in range(states):
                count[:, j] = np.bincount(ids, weights=gamma[:, j], minlength=len(type_ids))
            assert np.allclose(count.sum(axis=1), occurrence)
            posterior = theta * (channel.T @ (count / emission))
            theta = (posterior + PSEUDOCOUNT) / (posterior + PSEUDOCOUNT).sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
        assert min(np.diff(objectives)) >= -1e-5
        diagnostics.append({"start": start, "map_objectives": objectives})
        if best is None or objectives[-1] > best[0]:
            best = (objectives[-1], start, emission)
    rng_control = np.full((1, states), OOV_MASS, dtype=np.float64)
    eff_emission = np.vstack(((1 - OOV_MASS) * best[2], rng_control))
    assert np.allclose(eff_emission.sum(axis=0), 1)
    return type_ids, eff_emission, {
        "selected_start": best[1],
        "types": len(type_ids),
        "ambiguous_types": ambiguous,
        "endings": len(ending_rank),
        "em_iterations": ITERATIONS,
        "starts": diagnostics,
    }


def transform(words, vocabulary):
    return np.array([vocabulary.get(word, len(vocabulary)) for word in words], dtype=np.int32)

"""Extract three independent Latin book-I controls from archived source bytes."""
import csv
import hashlib
import html
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from vs import refcorpus


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RAW = ROOT / "external-raw"
TEI = "{http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0}"


def caesar(path):
    xml = ET.parse(path)
    book = xml.find(f".//{TEI}div[@subtype='book'][@n='1']")
    if book is None:
        raise ValueError("missing Caesar book I")
    paragraphs = list(book.iter(f"{TEI}p"))
    if len(paragraphs) != 302:
        raise ValueError(f"unexpected Caesar paragraph count: {len(paragraphs)}")
    return "\n".join("".join(p.itertext()) for p in paragraphs)


def paragraphs(path):
    source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    start = re.search(r"<body\b[^>]*>", source, re.I)
    end = re.search(r"<table\b", source[start.end():], re.I)
    body = source[start.end():start.end() + end.start()]
    for raw_text in re.findall(r"<p\b[^>]*>(.*?)</p\s*>", body, re.I | re.S):
        yield html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]*>", "", raw_text)).strip()


def bede(path):
    lines = [line for line in paragraphs(path) if line]
    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^\[1\]\s+Brittania", line))
    return "\n".join(lines[start:])


def kempis(path):
    return "\n".join(line for line in paragraphs(path) if re.match(r"^\d+\.\s", line))


def sha256(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    alphabet = set(next(csv.reader((ROOT / "hermes-polygraphia-iii.csv").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines())))
    specs = {
        "caesar_gallico_i": {
            "author": "Julius Caesar",
            "title": "De bello Gallico, Book I",
            "date": "c. 50 BCE",
            "edition": "T. Rice Holmes, Clarendon Press, 1914; Perseus 2.5 Latin TEI",
            "url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerseusDL/canonical-latinLit/master/data/phi0448/phi001/phi0448.phi001.perseus-lat2.xml",
            "catalog_url": "https://atlas.perseus.tufts.edu/library/urn:cts:latinLit:phi0448.phi001.perseus-lat2/",
            "license": "CC BY-SA 4.0, as declared in the TEI",
            "raw": "caesar.xml",
            "extract": caesar,
            "cleaning": "Extract and concatenate paragraph text from TEI book n=1 only, including inline editorial additions but excluding headers and Hirtian supplement.",
        },
        "bede_historia_i": {
            "author": "Bede",
            "title": "Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum, Book I",
            "date": "731 CE",
            "edition": "Latin Library digital text; print edition not declared on the source page",
            "url": "https://www.thelatinlibrary.com/bede/bede1.shtml",
            "license": "Ancient source text, open web transcription; no digital edition license stated on source page",
            "raw": "bede.html",
            "extract": bede,
            "cleaning": "Extract HTML paragraphs from the opening numbered chapter paragraph through the end of Book I, excluding navigation and the footer table.",
        },
        "kempis_imitatio_i": {
            "author": "Thomas à Kempis (traditional attribution)",
            "title": "De imitatione Christi, Book I",
            "date": "15th century",
            "edition": "Latin Library digital text; print edition not declared on the source page",
            "url": "https://www.thelatinlibrary.com/kempis/kempis1.shtml",
            "catalog_url": "https://gerson.crc.nd.edu/texts/T01759/",
            "license": "Historical source text, open web transcription; no digital edition license stated on source page",
            "raw": "kempis.html",
            "extract": kempis,
            "cleaning": "Extract numbered HTML prose paragraphs in Book I, omitting chapter headings and footer navigation.",
        },
    }
    output = ROOT / "external-texts"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    manifest = {}
    for identifier, spec in specs.items():
        raw_path = RAW / spec.pop("raw")
        extract = spec.pop("extract")
        content = "".join(c for c in refcorpus.normalize(extract(raw_path), "latin") if c in alphabet)
        if len(content) < 24000:
            raise ValueError(f"insufficient {identifier} length {len(content)}")
        target = output / f"{identifier}.txt"
        target.write_text(content, encoding="ascii")
        manifest[identifier] = {
            **spec,
            "file": str(target.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "raw_file": str(raw_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "raw_sha256": sha256(raw_path),
            "sha256": sha256(target),
            "letters": len(content),
            "normalization": "vs.refcorpus.normalize(text, 'latin'), then retain only Hermes Polygraphia III alphabet letters and join without spaces.",
        }
    staging = ROOT / "external-texts.json.tmp"
    staging.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    staging.rename(ROOT / "external-texts.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Summarize results by panel, source, key and control family."""
from collections import defaultdict
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
results = json.loads((WORK / "recovery-results.json").read_text())
original = json.loads((WORK / "recovery-results-before-diagnostics.json").read_text())
assert len(results) == len(original) == 60
for a, b in zip(results, original):
    assert all(a[m]["accuracy"] == b[m]["accuracy"] for m in ("soft", "prior", "row_frequency"))
    assert a["lag"] == b["lag"]
sources = json.loads((WORK / "external-texts.json").read_text())
for x in sources.values():
    assert hashlib.sha256((WORK / x["file"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == x["sha256"]
    assert hashlib.sha256((WORK / x["raw_file"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == x["raw_sha256"]


def summarize(rows):
    models = ("soft", "prior", "row_frequency")
    outcome = {
        "n": len(rows),
        "source_count": len({r["source"] for r in rows}),
        "mean_accuracy": {m: mean(r[m]["accuracy"] for r in rows) for m in models},
        "range_accuracy": {m: [min(r[m]["accuracy"] for r in rows),
                               max(r[m]["accuracy"] for r in rows)] for m in models},
        "mean_type_accuracy": {m: mean(r[m]["macro_type_accuracy"] for r in rows) for m in models},
        "mean_test_only_global_relabel": {m: mean(r[m]["test_only_global_relabel_accuracy"] for r in rows)
                                         for m in models},
        "test_only_modal_letter_mean": mean(r["soft"]["test_only_majority_frequency"] for r in rows),
        "soft_top3_accuracy_mean": mean(r["soft"]["top3_accuracy"] for r in rows),
        "soft_top_posterior_mean": mean(r["soft"]["mean_top_posterior"] for r in rows),
        "soft_win_count": sum(r["soft"]["accuracy"] > r["prior"]["accuracy"] for r in rows),
        "soft_vocab_mean": mean(r["soft"]["decoded_letter_types"] for r in rows),
        "soft_oov_max": max(r["oov_share"] for r in rows),
        "full_row_table_top1_min": min(r["row_table"]["best_by_unigram_accuracy"] for r in rows),
        "full_row_table_set_accuracy_min": min(r["row_table"]["candidate_set_accuracy"] for r in rows),
        "confirmed_lags": [r["lag"]["confirmed"] for r in rows],
        "held_soft_order_significance": {},
        "held_prior_order_significance": {},
    }
    for test in ("global", "inferred", "oracle_cyclic"):
        valid = [r["held_order_nulls"][test] for r in rows if r["held_order_nulls"][test] is not None]
        for method, kind in (("soft_nll_p", "soft"), ("prior_hard_nll_p", "prior")):
            outcome[f"held_{kind}_order_significance"][test] = {
                "tested": len(valid), "p_le_0.05": sum(r[method] <= 0.05 for r in valid),
            }
    return outcome


groups = defaultdict(list)
books = defaultdict(list)
for r in results:
    groups[f"{r['kind']}/{r['rows']}/{r['mode']}"].append(r)
    if r["kind"] == "real":
        books[r["source"]].append(r)
summary = {
    "all_real": summarize([r for r in results if r["kind"] == "real"]),
    "by_cell": {name: summarize(rows) for name, rows in groups.items()},
    "by_source": {name: summarize(rows) for name, rows in books.items()},
    "accuracy_and_period_unchanged_with_diagnostics": True,
    "source_hash_checks": len(sources) * 2,
}
(WORK / "recovery-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
